WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p.product_color, '<no color>') AS product_color,
    SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS invoiced_amount
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, '<no color>')
),
color_shares AS (
  SELECT
    product_color,
    invoiced_amount,
    invoiced_amount / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM color_totals
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_per_color
  FROM color_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(cs.invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount,
  AVG(cs.share_of_total) AS average_share,
  AVG(cs.invoiced_amount - a.average_per_color) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average
FROM color_shares AS cs
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE cs.invoiced_amount > a.average_per_color;
